text:
Nina (CSM): kicking off Verdant UX onboarding. They want Redwood to run recommendations with <=80ms p95 and a pilot-to-GA timeline of ~10 weeks. Renewal is annual; flag for early renewal review at month 10.
Sam (AE): noted. They asked about Dedicated after pilot if throughput >250rps. Also SOC2 and KMS questions from procurement.
Ravi (SE): I'll need a sample QPS profile + token length histogram. Also want a small sandbox dataset to simulate tail latencies.
Tess (Onboarding): draft 30/60/90: 30d = API + auth + basic evals; 60d = performance tuning + runbook; 90d = canary + handoff. I'll schedule weekly enablement calls.
Luis (Support): setting up a PD rotation for the pilot. If they hit >50rps p50 spikes, notify support.
Nina (CSM): risks: PII in payloads; procurement may push for Private deployment. Capture SOC2 evidence and KMS language. If GA slips past 90d, renewal risk increases. :warning:
Ravi (SE): actions for me: provision sandbox, deploy two model variants (quantized low-latency + standard), add tracing. Need their infra contact and sample error logs.
provision-bot: sandbox org `verdant-sbx-1991` created, API key in vault.
Tess (Onboarding): first enablement session Tue 10am PT with their infra lead. I'll post agenda and invite.
Sam (AE): I'll update the contract appendix: Dedicated trigger at 250rps, SOC2 addendum. Looping legal for KMS wording.
Nina (CSM): I'll request sample traces and confirm stakeholder list. I'll compile a 1-pager with owners and milestones after the call.
All: please confirm actions.
Sam (AE): confirmed.
Ravi (SE): confirmed.
Tess (Onboarding): confirmed.
Luis (Support): confirmed.
Nina (CSM): thanks — will share doc by EOD.
